title: Trial: safely implement and merge multiplication

tasks.title: Implement multiply(a,b) with tests
tasks.description: In src/math.mjs add a named export multiply(a,b) returning the product without changing add(). Add coverage in test/math.test.mjs for positive, negative, and zero values. Make the actual code and test edits, run npm test, and commit the result. Never modify the GitHub workflow file or repository settings.
acceptanceCriteria: src/math.mjs exports multiply(3,4) as 12, multiply(-2,3) as -6, and multiply(5,0) as 0.
test/math.test.mjs contains independent tests for multiply, preserving the existing add tests.
npm test passes and implementation changes are committed with a clean Git Worktree.
